name: OPAIJA_STYLE_GOD_MEMORY
purpose: Permanent brand/style lock for every future Opaija character, model sheet, prompt, video, thumbnail, and merch concept.

provenance.source: Current approved Opaija character sheets generated in ChatGPT/OpenAI workflow; uploaded ChatGPT bible sheets are canonical style/identity references

style_lock.linework: clean black ink, animated-series model-sheet clarity, readable silhouettes
style_lock.faces: rounded chins, full lips, broader African and Caribbean nose structures, distinct eyes and face shape per character
style_lock.hair: cool African and island-flavored hairstyles: locs, wraps, beads, shells, braid patterns, Carnival/Kalenda-inspired accents
style_lock.palette: black/charcoal base with controlled gold, orange, red, teal, sea blue, cream, and island-specific accent colors
style_lock.wardrobe: modern Caribbean streetwear fused with Kalenda/Calinda, Carnival, family emblems, island textiles, and practical movement gear
style_lock.props: bois, drums, L-shaped sticks, lavway symbols, bells, sashes, scarves, food/vendor objects, maps, charms, and coded paper sigils
style_lock.composition: professional model sheet with turnaround, action pose, relaxed pose, casual pose, head angles, expressions, gear, color palette, profile, scale notes, and signature line
style_lock.animation_need: duplicable for Seedance/Remotion workflows with consistent proportions, colors, face design, and wardrobe logic

premium_trailer_quality_lock.target: premium cinematic 2D Trini anime action-trailer quality
visual_traits: controlled gold/orange Opaija energy and staff lightning
warm rim light, heavy contrast, dramatic shadows, sharp anime/comic finish
flying debris, cracked ground, impact sparks, readable staff silhouettes
kinetic low-angle martial poses and expensive franchise-ready trailer framing
premium_trailer_quality_lock.character_priority: The ChatGPT/OpenAI bible sheets in public/assets/characters remain the identity source of truth. The trailer reference controls finish, lighting, camera, energy, and quality only.
premium_trailer_quality_lock.text_rule: Do not bake generated title text, fake signage, labels, subtitles, or logos into artwork by default. Add title/CTA/captions in Remotion/editor layer.
premium_trailer_quality_lock.crop_rule: For full-body and action panels, the complete staff/bois must remain visible tip-to-tip with safe margin. Cropped weapons, cropped hands, cropped feet, or cut-off hero silhouettes fail QC.

negative_lock: Do not use pointed V-shaped generic anime chins.
Do not flatten noses or lips into generic anime features.
Do not drift into medieval fantasy armor.
Do not wash out the Caribbean palette.
Do not remove cultural specificity from Kalenda/Calinda, bois, lavway, drums, gayelle, Carnival, food, island architecture, or folklore.
Do not invent random symbols that conflict with the Opaija mark system.
prompt_core: Create in the locked OPAIJA 2D Caribbean anime model-sheet style from the supplied ChatGPT bible sheets: rounded chin, full lips, broad African/Caribbean nose language, expressive warm eyes, clean black ink linework, bright island energy, modern Caribbean streetwear fused with Kalenda/Calinda and Carnival-inspired details, controlled gold/orange/red/teal/cream/purple accents as character-appropriate, flat cel-shaded animated-series clarity, duplicable proportions for Seedance and Remotion. For trailers, use premium dark cinematic Trini anime action quality: gold/orange energy, warm rim lighting, debris, cracked ground, kinetic low-angle martial poses, sharp anime/comic finish, and expensive franchise-ready contrast while preserving the exact bible-sheet character design. Keep complete staffs/bois visible tip-to-tip with safe margins in action panels. Do not drift into pseudo-3D, plastic, painterly, photoreal, or generic AI fantasy art.

anime_timing_rule.formula: words_per_second = target_wpm / 60; narration_duration = scene_word_count / words_per_second; final_clip_duration = narration_duration + pre_action_hold + impact_hold + transition_buffer
hard_gates: Do not animate unless every panel has narration, word count, calculated duration, action beat, and final clip duration.
Seedance duration must come from timing-sheet.json instead of generic storyboard defaults.
Final edit must trim or extend clips to timing-sheet.json before muxing audio.
Mark the run timing_failed if final video duration differs from voiceover duration by more than 0.5 seconds.

vertical_power_teaser_rule.long_form_rule: 30-minute episodes are compilation specials built later from 20-30 vertical chapters.
vertical_power_teaser_rule.audio_rule: Use action-first VO with 2-3 short lines max. SFX, music hits, and impacts carry the fight timing.
hard_gates: Voice lines must land before the action they set up or after the impact they reveal.
Every impact action needs a synced sound cue.
Teaser audio, visual, and beat-grid duration must differ by no more than 0.25 seconds.
No paid animation should start until the audio-action beat sheet, style lock, and storyboard pose prompts pass QC.
